summary: Motorsport Games Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that at its April 23, 2026 annual meeting, stockholders approved the exercise of warrants issued July 29, 2024 to purchase up to 949,310 shares of Class A common stock. The warrants include Series A (460,830 shares at $2.17, expiring Oct 23, 2031) and Series B (460,830 shares at $2.17, expiring Oct 25, 2027), plus 27,650 shares at $2.17125 for placement agent compensation. No price, premium, or tactical event is present; the filing merely removes a contractual exercise restriction on existing warrants, making it a routine corporate housekeeping matter with no special-situation catalyst.
